ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels concentrated on the distal lobes and 35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the medial and trailing edge regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive white pigmentation across the outer lobes. Dark pigmentation is focused along the center line (peduncle area) and trailing edge. Distinct circular black mottling is present within the large white patches on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 30 degrees relative to the medial axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels; serrations are most jagged and clustered near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing margins of both lobes, terminating in sharp upward-pointing tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the outer distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned dark linear streaks visible on the ventral white field of the left lobe (image-left).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle encrustation on the distal tips; prominent white-on-black circular scarring located within the medial dark regions of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique, high-contrast white figure-eight or 'B' shaped scar cluster located in the dark medial zone of the left lobe.
